# crosswork_demand_matrix_global_configuration (Resource)

This resource can manage the global configuration of the demand matrix.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_demand_matrix_global_configuration" "example" {
  computation_cadence    = 30
  minimum_demand_traffic = 100
  debug_mode             = true
  debug_max_plan_files   = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `computation_cadence` (Number) Interval in minutes at which the demand matrix is computed
  - Range: `15`-`2147483647`
  - Default value: `15`
- `debug_max_plan_files` (Number) Maximum number of debug plan files to save
  - Range: `1`-`100`
  - Default value: `1`
- `debug_mode` (Boolean) Enables the debug optimizer
  - Default value: `false`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `minimum_demand_traffic` (Number) Demands with traffic below this value in Kbps are excluded from the demand matrix
  - Default value: `0`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_demand_matrix_global_configuration.example "demand_matrix_global_configuration"
```
